postInstall.message:
common-styling installed.

Scaffold a configured layout, a starter overrides stylesheet, and the required
instance setting in one step with the bundled install generator:

  pos-cli generate run modules/common-styling/generators/install

Prefer to wire things up by hand? See the module README for the manual steps:
https://github.com/Platform-OS/pos-modules/blob/master/pos-module-common-styling/README.md
